en-US.title: Temple — South India temples
en-US.subtitle: History, architecture, darshan
en-US.description:
Temple is a free guide to the oldest and greatest temples of South India. Discover each shrine's history, architecture, legends, festivals, and how to visit — written clearly and respectfully, in six languages (Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Hindi, and English). Every temple has narrated audio so you can listen instead of read.

- 100+ temples across Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, and Kerala
- Curated pilgrimage circuits (Pancha Bhoota Sthalams, the Great Living Chola Temples, Divya Desams, and more)
- Narrated audio for every temple, in all six languages
- Fast, works offline once visited, and free — no account required

Content-only and reverent: no ticketing, no donations handled in-app, and no ads or tracking.
